capabilities.description: Decompose a peer review into Atomic Review Comments (ARCs) and score each comment on actionability, specificity, justification, solution, and tone.
capabilities.title: Multi-dimensional constructiveness

capabilities.description: Extract verbatim flaw arguments from a review, verify them against the manuscript, merge semantically equivalent flaws into a consensus reference set, and label them as Critical or Minor. Reports severity-stratified recall and the normalized Critique Prioritization Score (nCPS).
capabilities.title: Flaw identification and prioritization

capabilities.description: Score the depth of a peer review by extracting argumentative discourse units (ADUs), labeling each as claim or premise, and checking whether the premises are grounded in the manuscript or the surrounding literature.
capabilities.title: Depth of analysis

capabilities.description: Extract verbatim novelty claims from a review, retrieve related papers from Semantic Scholar, and verify whether the retrieved literature supports or contradicts each claim. Reports a normalized novelty-support score and support rate.
capabilities.title: Novelty assessment

description: PRISM (Peer Review Intelligence via Structured Multi-dimensional assessment) is a benchmark that evaluates LLM-generated and human peer reviews of machine learning papers across four orthogonal dimensions: depth of analysis, novelty assessment, flaw identification and prioritization, and multi-dimensional constructiveness.
name: PRISM Benchmark

papers.title: PRISM: A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Peer Reviewers
